check_order: shape (malformed) / payload type (payload_type) -> signatures (threshold_not_met) -> policy parse (malformed) -> tenant (wrong_tenant) -> version (version_not_newer) -> expiry (expired)

cases.name: valid
cases.why: 2 distinct trusted signatures, newer, unexpired

cases.name: valid-three-sigs
cases.why: 3 of 3 trusted signatures

cases.name: valid-from-empty
cases.why: first policy on a fresh proxy

cases.name: one-sig
cases.why: only 1 signature, threshold is 2

cases.name: duplicate-key
cases.why: same key twice counts once

cases.name: untrusted-second
cases.why: outsider is not in the trust root

cases.name: flipped-sig
cases.why: admin-b's signature bytes altered

cases.name: tampered-payload
cases.why: payload changed after signing (one added space)

cases.name: short-sig
cases.why: signature is not 64 bytes: shape check fails first

cases.name: wrong-payload-type
cases.why: validly signed, but not a Kairan policy

cases.name: malformed-policy
cases.why: validly signed, but default is "allow"

cases.name: wrong-tenant
cases.why: validly signed policy for city-b

cases.name: old-version
cases.why: v1 offered to a proxy on v2 (rollback replay)

cases.name: same-version
cases.why: v2 offered to a proxy already on v2

cases.name: expired
cases.why: expired a day before Now

cases.name: expired-within-skew
cases.why: expired 1 minute before Now; skew is 2 minutes

cases.name: duplicate-role
cases.why: validly signed, but role "sales" appears twice (the second grants crm.* X)

cases.name: duplicate-tool
cases.why: validly signed, but tool "crm.read_*" appears twice in role sales (R, then X)

cases.name: case-variant-field
cases.why: validly signed, but the field is "Tenant", not "tenant"

cases.name: raw-payload-sig
cases.why: admin-a and admin-b signed the raw payload, not the DSSE PAE

cases.name: mislabeled-keyid
cases.why: admin-b's genuine signature carries admin-c's key ID; only admin-a counts

cases.name: nine-sigs
cases.why: 9 valid trusted signatures, over the cap of 8: shape check fails first

cases.name: trailing-bytes
cases.why: validly signed, but a second JSON value follows the policy

cases.name: issued-after-expires
cases.why: validly signed, but issued_at is a day after expires_at (both in the future)
